request.acceptance_criteria: every status word and group derived from records, tested; ticfac status --json carries them; make gate
request.description: In internal/statusmodel, derive for every tick a status word (waiting on X / up next / claimed / writing code / testing / merged / reviewing / closing out / waiting for CI / held: reason / failed: reason / done) from the existing pipeline derivation (pipeline.go), plus an inline exception note (attempt N, model escalated, stalled Nm) only when it applies; the epic-level phase (building wave i of n / reviewing / closing out / PR & CI / merged) with a you-are-here index; the needs-you item(s) with their exact clearing command; and tick groups NOW/DONE/UP NEXT/HELD. Versioned in the status model JSON (ticfac status --json) so watch and the phone page share it. Unit tests per status word and per group, from recorded fixtures.
request.title: Status model: plain-language tick status, epic phase track, needs-you, ticks grouped by state
